'''Ras Andromias''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Stationed at the Jedi Temple on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], he and his minions encounter a spacer and were defeated. Andromias wielded a [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], and was able to harness the power of [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Ras Andromias was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TNH" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Ras Andromias was added to the game along with the [[W:c:swg:Axkva Min|"Axkva Min" Heroic Encounter]],<ref name="SWG:TNH" /> introduced with the release of the [[W:c:swg:Chapter 7 Notes for Nov 1 2007|"Chapter 7" update]], on [[November 1]], [[2007]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 7: A Collection of Heroes">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67485&month=102007|text=Chapter 7: A Collection of Heroes}}</ref>
